gaps.gap: Reversible is fully covered: reversalRef is produced with the promotion and surfaced in the modal, asserted server-side and client-side. Audited is emitted and asserted in-process - a test proves capture.promoted is appended naming the acting persona and the corrected fields - but it cannot LAND upstream. ProjexCloud rejects it with UnregisteredEventType because capture.promoted, like all 32 LeadFlow event names, is absent from EVENT_TYPE_REGISTRY, a closed code constant in packages/contracts that a consuming app has no endpoint or documented path to extend. Same blocker as bd5ea1b4#AC4, recorded as defect 6 in docs/projexcloud-defects.md. appendAuditEntry never throws by design so nothing fails, but the chain stays empty.
